description: Hand-reviewed agent MCP configuration cases (split plan §6.4, U12, U92). Each case names an agent (codex|claude|copilot|gemini|antigravity|cursor|roo|junie), a scope (project|user), a file path and the file's source text (null: the file is absent; only connect is exercised). 'observations' are the injected facts: endpointUrl (live endpoint or null), trustInstalled (true|false|null = unknown), connections (connection id -> {"owned": url} | "not_owned"; an unlisted id is unavailable), paths (path -> false = absent | null = unknown; an unlisted path exists) and verifiedLaunchers. 'findings' are the expected AgentConfigFinding objects in order (the free-text 'detail' is not compared); 'entries' are every recognized entry with its status (null = unclassified because an observation is unavailable). Optional 'connect' {serverKey, connectionId, url, airkctl}, 'repair' {containerPath, serverKey, connectionId, url, airkctl} and 'remove' {containerPath, serverKey} each carry 'expect': {"text": exact resulting file} | {"unchanged": true} | {"refused": true}. Consumers: crates/airkctl/src/agents/config/tests.rs and the extension's removal-only recognizer.

# Codex project settings
model = "gpt-5"

[mcp_servers.docs]
command = "npx"
args = ["docs-mcp"]
enabled = false

# AIRK
[mcp_servers.airk]
url = "https://127.0.0.1:4433/mcp"
http_headers_helper = "/opt/airk/bin/airkctl agents credential --connection-id 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --format header-json"
enabled_tools = ["search", "read_file"] # policy

[mcp_servers.airk.http_headers]
"X-AIRK-Response-Mode" = "terse"
